title: Saudi Arabian Peanut Cookies Broil
description: A fermented and crumbly peanut cookie dish originating from Saudi Arabia, perfect for a snack or dessert. This recipe is friendly to those looking for anti-inflammatory options, and can be served in a terracotta dish.
instructions: Soak 1 cup of dates in water for 4 hours and blend into a smooth paste.
In a large bowl, mix together 1 cup of peanut butter, 1/2 cup of coconut sugar, and 1/4 cup of coconut oil until well combined.
Add 1/4 teaspoon of salt and 1/4 teaspoon of baking soda to the mixture and stir well.
Add 2 tablespoons of yogurt and 1 tablespoon of vinegar to the mixture and stir until smooth.
Gradually add 2 tablespoons of oats to the mixture and stir until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and pliable.
Divide the dough into 12 equal pieces and shape each piece into a ball.
Place the balls onto a terracotta dish lined with parchment paper, leaving about 1 inch of space between each cookie.
Broil the cookies in a preheated oven at 375°F (190°C) for 10-12 minutes, or until they are lightly browned.
Remove the cookies from the oven and let them cool for 5 minutes before serving.
